action.message:
Implemented the repair in src/dotenv/main.py only.

Change (set_key, lines 184-187): when quoting, backslashes are now escaped before apostrophes:

    value_out = "'{}'".format(
        value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")
    )

This aligns the writer with the parser's single-quote escape set (`\\`, `\'`), so literal backslashes, consecutive backslashes, and backslash-before-apostrophe sequences round-trip exactly through `dotenv_values(interpolate=False)`. The `quote_mode` selection logic and `export` handling are untouched, and no other files were modified.
